notes: The AT Act report (demonstrations, loans, reuse by federal fiscal year) and QuickBooks Online invoices and payments. Apply dist/migrations/mig_4.21.0.sql, or use Database upgrade (Software update applies it on its own). Outlook calendar sync (sessions in each staff member's calendar, Outlook busy times respected) and client self-booking in the portal. Apply dist/migrations/mig_4.20.0.sql, or use Database upgrade (Software update applies it on its own). Check for updates fixed for older sites (checks GitHub unless set to off) and never shows an old check as current; Software update also updates older sites' scheduled jobs. No database change. Each client's state asked for at intake (it sets their reminder and text times), the organisation's time zone in its own Settings section, page-error alerts by email, clearer update messages. No database change since 4.17.0. One-button updates from GitHub (set Settings, Updates to github; then Administration, Software update), your own phone apps (Administration, Phone apps), and texts for clients with no state on record. No database change since 4.17.0. Text messages through Twilio: answerable session reminders, session and homework notices, texted messages and urgent staff alerts. Apply dist/migrations/mig_4.17.0.sql, or use Database upgrade; sites below 4.16.0 first apply mig_4.16.0.sql. Staff training, holding client records until it is done, credentials, the exit acknowledgement and the staff compliance report: apply dist/migrations/mig_4.16.0.sql; sites below 4.15.0 first apply mig_4.15.0.sql. Apply dist/migrations/mig_4.15.0.sql (staff_agreements, staff_agreement_signatures), or use Database upgrade; sites below 4.11.0 first apply mig_4.11.0.sql. Apply dist/migrations/mig_4.11.0.sql, or use Database upgrade; sites below 4.10.0 apply mig_3.0.47 to mig_4.10.0 first. Sites below 3.0.45 apply the earlier migrations first, in order. Sites below 3.0.31 also apply mig_3.0.31.sql; Apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.31.sql (confirms client emails waiting for confirmation). Sites below 3.0.28 apply mig_3.0.28.sql (adds scheduled_sessions.checked_in_at) before updating files; sites below 3.0.27 apply mig_3.0.27.sql first. Sites on 3.0.16 to 3.0.20 apply mig_3.0.21.sql first. Older sites apply mig_3.0.8, 3.0.9, 3.0.10, 3.0.12, 3.0.16, 3.0.21, 3.0.27, 3.0.28, 3.0.31, 3.0.34, 3.0.35, 3.0.36, 3.0.37, 3.0.38, 3.0.39, 3.0.40, 3.0.42, 3.0.43, 3.0.44, 3.0.45, 3.0.47, 3.0.48, 3.0.49, 3.0.50, 3.0.51, 3.0.52, 3.0.53, 3.0.54, 3.0.55, 4.0.0, 4.1.0, 4.2.0, 4.3.0, 4.4.0, 4.5.0, 4.6.0, 4.7.0, 4.8.0, 4.9.0, 4.10.0, 4.11.0, 4.15.0, 4.16.0 and 4.17.0 in order; all are safe to re-run, except that migrations before 4.5.0 must not be run again once you have added your own values to its lists.
contact: Download the install bundle from the GitHub release (https://github.com/amenathomas1997/Case-Management-System/releases). From 4.18.0 on, Administration, Software update installs new versions with one button.
